notes: A January 2025 Road No. 36 panorama was opened in Chrome at the nearest mapped street point to the provisional Madhapur station marker. The view is roughly 33 m from that marker and shows elevated Metro structure, a raised planted divider, paved carriageway, cars, motorcycles, auto-rickshaws and pedestrians, plus a legible Zuri Skin Clinic sign. The marker is not a verified station gate; no complete frontage order, exact road side or measured geometry is claimed. Google imagery remains reference-only.
